Removing the protected land constraint in Table U.E4, we can see that the only major barrier to data center siting in Emery County comes from the slope criteria. The myriad canyons and mountains in the county still create discontinuities in suitability within Central, Northeast, and Northwest Emery. Looking finally to the potential for collocation in Emery County, we see again that the limiting factor comes down to potential locations for nuclear reactors. Eastern Emery County seems most suitable for water-cooled SMR technology due to the relaxed slope constraint, whereas the western end of the county sees more viability for dry-cooled SMRs. 67 Table
